status: locked before fitting; offline exploratory historical relations and replay only
phase1_input_policy: verify manifest bytes, all eight listed artifacts and both listed source-file hashes before fitting and after export; never modify phase1
primary_eligibility: original eligibility strict, fixed seven factors strict and three good level candidates; common_valid in frozen phase1
lag_comparison: same assay IDs, labels and seven nonlevel inputs for every lag; compare recorded matching candidates, not physical delay

predictor_units.coal_amount: t/h of raw coal feed already used by the eight-factor model

learned_fit_policy: for each declared training set compute its one-pass label fence, then fit the four models on its common normal training IDs; retain every excluded raw label and ID; no residual filtering and no additional raw-fit candidates

normal_fence.shared: once per training set, identical across all lags and models; test normal membership uses only that training-derived fence

numerical_policy.solver: numpy.linalg.lstsq on intercept plus training-mean-centered, population-standard-deviation-scaled predictors
numerical_policy.rank_requirement: rank equals number of coefficients and clean_n >= coefficient_count+1; otherwise unidentifiable with no usable coefficients or prediction
numerical_policy.extrapolation: flag any predictor outside this fit's normal-training min/max; retain and score finite predictions, never reject an error-prone input to improve accuracy
numerical_policy.coefficient_reporting: raw-unit intercept and slopes, centered intercept, training center/scale and predictor min/max; slope per 1 and per 10 level pp, per 1 and per 100 t/h

full_history.fence_training: all 34 primary labels only; do not reuse a previously published whole-history fence
full_history.scoring: predict all 34 rows after fitting normal training IDs; report normal/all and single out excluded labels
full_history.interpretation: descriptive historical fit, not validation or a production model

historical_replay.availability: observed_at and created_at must both be strictly earlier than that prediction date's Asia/Shanghai 00:00; no same-day earlier sample labels
historical_replay.minimum_gate_note: existing operational gate, not evidence that n=5 is adequate to establish an 80 percent success claim
historical_replay.target_quality: primary frozen common strict cohort only; approximate and label-review rows never upgraded
historical_replay.fence_policy: each date's fence is computed once from its prior available raw training labels; never use the full-history fence for test membership
historical_replay.availability_limitation: created_at is initial entry time; precise report and revision availability not reconstructed, so this is not an exact online replay

baselines.empirical_raw: 30.5 - 0.3*level without new clipping, matching the existing empirical_raw research reference
baselines.frozen_expert8: existing app.gpt_coarse.expert8.predict, including its original clamps and corrections; no refitting
baselines.policy: score both references on each lag's same target inputs; references are not assigned the clean-training coefficients

metrics.counts: hit1/n and hit2/n, not a percentage without denominator
metrics.uncertainty: Wilson 95 percent interval for hit1 rate, z=1.96; conditional normal score is not a known-at-prediction subgroup
metrics.coverage: eligible, predicted, rejected or skipped with reasons and IDs; score every finite extrapolation
metrics.comparability: report native coverage first, then scores on the intersection of target IDs predicted by all six fixed methods and all three lags in that phase
metrics.dates: include per-date normal/all scores and counts, not only aggregate

forced_invariants: M0 and M2 parameters, per-row predictions, coverage and scores must be exactly equal across lags, not merely approximately equal
all lags and models share the same raw training IDs, normal training IDs, excluded training IDs and fence for each fold
same target labels and same nonlevel factor values across lags
every replay training observed_at and created_at is strictly before its date cutoff
frozen phase1 manifest and its files remain byte-for-byte unchanged
two_system_scope: only describe each frozen strict common combination separately (5/4/3 rows): dates, three level ranges, coal and ash ranges and missing coverage; no fitting, borrowing three-system predictions or extrapolating a narrow range to all two-system conditions
selection_and_stopping: no winner-selection rule, no automatic deployment, no hyperparameter search, no polynomial or rescue candidates; report the fixed experiment once even if accuracy is below target
prior_data_use: all current labels and historical tail have already been viewed; lag/feature/model comparisons are development and historical replay, never new independent validation
sampling_time_limitation: phase1 actual sampling precision and clock source remain unconfirmed; no retrospective 39-second or source-clock shift
outputs: locked protocol, input hashes, training fences and IDs, numerical diagnostics/coefficients/ranges, all predictions/rejections, scores/coverage/per-date results, two-system descriptive coverage, invariant checks and report; no production or baseline writes
